What an invoice should include

A good invoice includes your business name, customer details, invoice date, due date, items, quantity, rate, tax, discount, total and payment terms.

GST-ready when needed

Add GST/VAT IDs and tax fields when you need a GST-ready invoice. Keep it simple when GST is not required.
